message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full suite is green (18 of 18).

**The cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 came out as "¥5.00".

**The fix:** I changed only `src/payments/receipt.js`. For JPY, `renderReceipt` now prints the amount as whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`. I didn't touch `src/utils/money.js` because `CLAUDE.md` says other teams own everything outside `src/payments`.

**Not fixed:** the same bug exists in the shared helper, so any other caller that formats yen (invoices, cart, admin) will still show it wrong. That needs a fix in `src/utils/money.js` by its owners, or a zero-decimal-currency check there. I haven't committed anything.
